Account cards in the scope bar are text-matched by label; 'spread-test' account has stale EA heartbeat (~319k s) so activation is always blocked.
rca of the issue: RCA: The 409 response body from /api/bot/start and PUT /api/bot/config has shape {detail:{code,message,problems:[...]}}. Old formatApiError only returned detail.message, dropping the problems array — so the UI banner showed a bare 'Live activation blocked — fix these first:' with nothing after the colon. Fix: after picking detail.message, collect string items from detail.problems || detail.blockers || detail.reasons and join with ' · '. Reproduction: login as admin, /bot, pick spread-test, click START BOT → banner shows message + 3 concrete problems (broker disconnected, EA heartbeat stale, EA version unknown). Backend curl verified: POST /api/bot/start?account_id=<spread-test> → 409, detail.problems.length==3.
